signal_text: Etsy's help center states that, as of August 29, 2025, most packages shipped to the US are subject to tariffs, with the cost handled either as Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) — where the seller pays the tariff upfront, included in the checkout total — or Delivered Duty Unpaid (DDU) — where the buyer pays any tariffs and fees directly to the carrier upon delivery, depending on the shipping method the seller selects.
subject_exact: Etsy tariff responsibility split between DDP and DDU shipping methods for US-bound packages as of August 29, 2025
local_qualifiers: most packages shipped to the US
normalization_notes: local_qualifiers trimmed: the DDP and DDU clause descriptions were full policy-clause sentences (claim content), not scope-limiting conditions; moved into signal_text, consistent with the rule that qualifiers hold conditions, not claim substance.

actor_level set to 'platform' (from inherited ['buyer','seller']): the speaker is Etsy's help center describing its own policy; 'mixed' would conflate who is affected (buyer or seller, depending on shipping method chosen) with who speaks, which is Etsy alone.
